Interface INetworkElementProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
NetworkElementProviderEmpty, NetworkElementProviderPartContainer, NetworkElementProviderSingleton
public interface INetworkElementProvider
Capability that can create instances of an INetworkElement. Blocks that provide this capability MUST properly call NetworkHelpers.onElementProviderBlockNeighborChange(Level, BlockPos, Direction).
